race.description: Geelong Cup On Sale Now Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: OMNIC (2) went forward last start over 1730m at this track and held on well for second, beaten a long neck. Followed another second placing here the start prior, which came after a couple of wins, so only needs to hold form to be the testing material. HAWK POWER (1) hasn't raced since a win at Bendigo over 1600m four weeks ago. Kept up to the mark with a placing in a recent trial at Geelong. Should be involved in the finish on his best form. BELLABAMA (11) has barely put a foot wrong this prep and was a dominant winner at a prohibitive quote last time. This is a step up, but she'll take confidence from that. KIWI JENNI (7) caught the eye last start at Seymour, which was her fourth run back. Peak fitness now and suited this trip. RAGAZZONE (3) is the most lightly-raced horse in the race and only won his maiden two back but stepped up to this company last start and ran a nice race - albeit beaten a long way - at a huge price. Don't overlook.
